author: Apple
description:
​@ErikTollefsrud shares some great tips to use in Messages, making your chats a breeze. Here’s how he does it ⬇️ 

• Tap and hold the Plus icon to quickly add Photos 
• Quickly reply to a message just by swiping right
• To add Live Stickers, long press on a message, tap Attach Sticker 
• Then tap the plus button, then tap the Live tab

Created by​ @ErikTollefsrud. Shared by Apple.

Music: Magnetic [Instrumental] - Jam City

#AppleMagic #iOS26 #iMessage #LiveStickers
